title: 26 CFR 301.6011-3, Partnership Returns Required on Magnetic Media (4-1-25 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, Code of Federal Regulations

passages.question: Must this return be filed electronically?
passages.excerpt: a partnership is required to file at least 10 returns if, during the calendar year ending with or within the taxable year of the partnership, the partnership is required to file at least 10 returns of any type
